heading: Establishment of Facility
lead: There is established in the Department of the Treasury an entity to be known as the “Conservation Facility” for the purpose of providing for the administration of debt reduction in accordance with this subchapter.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 804 of Pub. L. 87–195, pt. V, was classified to section 2434 of this title prior to repeal by Pub. L. 94–329.
Amendments2019—Pub. L. 115–440 substituted “Conservation Facility” for “Tropical Forest Facility”.

Change of Name Pub. L. 115–440, § 4(c), Jan. 14, 2019, 132 Stat. 5582, provided that: “Any reference in any other provision of law, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the ‘Tropical Forest Facility’ shall be deemed to be a reference to the ‘Conservation Facility’.”

ancestors.heading: DEBT REDUCTION FOR DEVELOPING COUNTRIES WITH TROPICAL FORESTS
